duplication_audit.concurrent_stop_reason: anonymous cases have no signed case-to-UTC or cross-station simultaneity linkage, so remote contemporaneous observations cannot be aligned at deployment
directional_duplicate_evidence: src/p3_wave/sea_state.py already implements inverse-wave-age and wind-sea growth features
p3_causal_forcing_conditioned_episode_analog_v2 already uses wind-wave alignment and directional wind input
duplication_audit.selected_axis: coordinate-graph Laplacian sharing of station-specific residual coefficients
duplication_audit.distinction: existing P3 models use station one-hot, station-specific normalization, shared models, or independent station effects; repository audit found no graph-Laplacian regularization that couples station-specific forecast coefficient matrices by fixed geographic geometry
duplication_audit.deployment_contract: requires only the case-local past 48h context, station ID, and three fixed station coordinates; no absolute case time and no remote contemporaneous observation

station_graph.coordinate_source: existing pinned repository KIOST station metadata in src/p3_wave/era5_pretrain_data.py
station_graph.inference: station-specific six-lead coefficient head regularized by weighted graph Laplacian; no message passing over query observations

features.missing_rule: case-local past-only linear interpolation with nearest endpoint fill; all-missing channel zero; missing fractions retained
features.train_fold_scaler: median and IQR, clip standardized features to [-8,8]

model.target: six-lead target_hs minus exact uniform alpha 0.425 reference
model.family: closed-form multi-output Ridge with graph-Laplacian station coefficient sharing

validation.surface: EXPLORATORY_ONLY repeatedly exposed 182 complete historical cases
validation.gate: delta RMSE below zero, at least 4/6 blocks improve, episode and block-station CI90 upper below zero, worst station-lead <=0.01m
